name: adv_naming_top_level_shadow
source:
// A top-level scalar whose name resembles a component-local mangled name:
// `PA_W` at top level next to PA.W from the component.
COMPONENT Lift(in, out)
  PARAM v, eta
  out.mdot = in.mdot
  out.h    = in.h + v * (out.P - in.P) / eta
  W        = in.mdot * (out.h - in.h)
END
COMPONENT FluidBoundary(out)
  PARAM P, h, mdot
  out.P    = P
  out.h    = h
  out.mdot = mdot
END
FluidBoundary SRC(f1, P = 200000, h = 154000, mdot = 1.0)
Lift          PA(f1, f2, v = 0.001, eta = 0.9)
Sink          SK(f2)
f2.P  = 300000
PA_W  = 7
ratio = PA.W / PA_W
